name: comms
description: Send an email or a text message as you, held at the Gate for your yes and logged on the client it went to.

credentials.purpose: Send text messages through your Twilio account

tips.text: Ask your assistant to text a client. It sends from your own Twilio number, and you say yes to the exact words first.

steps.name: comms.send
steps.label: Send an email or a text

settings.label: Text messages through Twilio
settings.help: Your Twilio account number (starts with AC) and the number texts come from: { "account": "AC...", "from": "+15555550123" }. Connect Twilio for Comms in the Vault (Connections) and paste your auth token. Every text waits for your yes.
